fromTurnId.description:
Summarize only from this turn on ("summarize from here"): the history before the turn's first user message stays verbatim; this turn and every later one are replaced by one summary. Absent = the whole thread. The turn must be a finished turn of the thread.

Agents older than this field ignore it and compact the whole thread. An empty value is refused before the thread is even looked up (`fromTurnId must not be empty`), so a client can probe for support without side effects by sending an empty `fromTurnId` with any thread id: older agents answer with the thread lookup error instead.

instructions.description: What the summary should focus on (`/compact <instructions>`); appended to the summarization prompt.
